what: digital SRAM compute-in-memory (cores accumulate in the array)

s.derivation: the cell share of a digital SRAM CIM macro (one macro: no held-out point of its own; held out, the analog share)

held_out.rule: every fitted value is re-derived with the held-out chip's entries removed (by id prefix); a point that reads one is dropped, a point that meets a named refusal is dropped by name
held_out.record: the toolchain's held-out estimate (area_rule/parity.py; tests T-6, T-27)

gamma.derivation: no T2 die publishes its core-grid share: the T1 dies' (flagged)

default_cell_factor.derivation: the type's definition: a plain logic-rule 6T (k_L carries its evidence; the strict hold-out's replacement of an own cell)
